title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "This show, this challenge, this wager upon my very own dignity… It's all for you, as well as a beloved schoolmate of mine."

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident A
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Our dorm leader is so beautiful even through a screen!

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident B
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she's doing this to lead the way for us? Oh my gosh, what if she really wins everything?!

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident C
text_block_list.text: If she does, I think I'll try for the Triple Crown tour even though I suck at turf races!

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If it's really that easy to overcome your innate weaknesses, I wouldn't have given up in the first place…
Excitement and nervousness fill the stands. Meanwhile, Fuji Kiseki is answering questions from reporters before the race.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I believe you said that you have a greater affinity with mile races during a recent press conference, yes?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's right. Add that to the fact that my costars are all strong competitors, and this won't be an easy race by any stretch.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today's race is 2,400 meters long! It's 400 meters longer than the Satsuki Sho, but I think I still have a fighting chance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And then, a 3,000-meter challenge awaits in the fall, so I'll need to think up some magic to help me then.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Thank you for the wonderful answer. Could you share your final thoughts with us, please?
Prompted by the reporter, Fuji Kiseki looks straight into the camera.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is the second summit I plan to conquer. This race is one full of possibility, and it's my gift to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on me, and look forward to my victory!
With that, a flurry of flower petals obscure the screen, and the impromptu interview comes to a close.
It's time for the curtains to rise on this G1 powerhouse showcase—the Japanese Derby!
